query.commandtext: INSERT INTO TBP_EQUIP_ALARM ( RES_ID ,SET_TIME ,CLR_TIME ,MONTH ,DAY ,SHIFT ,FACTORY ,OPER ,MAT_ID ,LOT_ID ,RECIPE_ID ,ALARM_ID ,ALARM_CAT ,ALARM_MSG ,STATE ,PERIOD ) VALUES( :res_id ,SYSTIMESTAMP ,SYSTIMESTAMP + 1/86400--초기 RELEASE 시간은 발생시간과 동일시간 ,TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP,'YYYYMM') ,TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP,'DD') ,DECODE( TRUNC(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP + (2/24),'HH24')) / 8) , 0 , 'N' , 1 , 'D' ,'S') ,:factory ,(SELECT RES_STS_8 AS OPER FROM MESMGR.MRASRESDEF@FATOMES WHERE RES_ID = :res_id) ,(SELECT RES_STS_2 AS MAT_ID FROM MESMGR.MRASRESDEF@FATOMES WHERE RES_ID = :res_id) ,:lot_id ,:recipe_id ,:alarm_id ,:alarm_cat ,:alarm_msg ,'S' ,1 )

UPDATE TBP_EQUIP_ALARM SET CLR_TIME = SYSTIMESTAMP , CLEAR_CAT = :clear_cat , CLEAR_MSG= :clear_msg , PERIOD = :period , EFFECT = :effect , STATE = 'C' WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND RES_ID = :res_id --AND ALARM_ID = :alarm_id -- 특정 설비에서 다른 아이디로 Alarm Clear 메시지가 들어와서 변경 AND ALARM_MSG = :clear_msg AND SET_TIME = (SELECT MAX(SET_TIME) FROM TBP_EQUIP_ALARM WHERE FACTORY = :factory AND RES_ID = :res_id AND SET_TIME > SYSTIMESTAMP-1 --AND ALARM_ID = :alarm_id -- 특정 설비에서 다른 아이디로 Alarm Clear 메시지가 들어와서 변경 AND ALARM_MSG = :clear_msg AND STATE = 'S')

SELECT TBP_EQUIP_ALARM.* ,SYSTIMESTAMP AS CURRTIME FROM TBP_EQUIP_ALARM WHERE SET_TIME >= SYSTIMESTAMP - 1 AND FACTORY = :factory AND RES_ID = :res_id --AND ALARM_ID <> :alarm_id AND ALARM_MSG <> :alarm_msg AND STATE = 'S' ORDER BY SET_TIME

SELECT RES_ID ,SET_TIME ,CLR_TIME ,MONTH ,DAY ,SHIFT ,FACTORY ,OPER ,MAT_ID ,LOT_ID ,RECIPE_ID ,ALARM_ID ,ALARM_CAT ,ALARM_MSG ,CLEAR_CAT ,CLEAR_MSG ,STATE ,PERIOD ,EFFECT ,SYSTIMESTAMP AS CURRTIME FROM TBP_EQUIP_ALARM WHERE SET_TIME >= SYSTIMESTAMP - 1 AND FACTORY = :factory AND RES_ID = :res_id --AND ALARM_ID = :alarm_id -- 특정 설비에서 다른 아이디로 Alarm Clear 메시지가 들어와서 변경 AND ALARM_MSG = :alarm_msg AND STATE = 'S' ORDER BY SET_TIME DESC

SELECT ALARM_ID, ??, CNT, EFFECT FROM (SELECT ALARM_ID, ??, COUNT(*) CNT, SUM(EFFECT) EFFECT, RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS RANK FROM TBP_EQUIP_ALARM WHERE SET_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:sttime,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(:endtime,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') ?? GROUP BY ALARM_ID, ??) WHERE 1 = 1 AND RANK <= :rcnt ORDER BY 3 DESC

SELECT RES_ID, TO_CHAR(SET_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS SET_TIME, TO_CHAR(CLR_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CLEAR_TIME, EFFECT, ALARM_ID, ALARM_MSG FROM TBP_EQUIP_ALARM WHERE 1=1 AND MONTH = TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(:today, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYYMM') AND DAY = TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(:today, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'DD') ?? ORDER BY RES_ID, SET_TIME

SELECT RES_ID, SET_TIME, CLR_TIME, OPER, MAT_ID, LOT_ID, RECIPE_ID, ALARM_MSG, CLEAR_MSG, PERIOD, EFFECT FROM TBP_EQUIP_ALARM WHERE 1=1 ?? AND SET_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:sttime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(:endtime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND ALARM_ID= :alarm_id ORDER BY SET_TIME

SELECT ALARM_ID, ALARM_MSG, CNT, EFFECT FROM (SELECT ALARM_ID, ALARM_MSG, COUNT(*) CNT, SUM(EFFECT) EFFECT, RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS RANK FROM TBP_EQUIP_ALARM WHERE 1=1 AND SET_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:sttime,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(:endtime,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') ?? GROUP BY ALARM_ID, ALARM_MSG) ALM,
(SELECT DISTINCT AREA_ID, SUB_AREA_ID FROM MESMGR.MRASRESDEF@FATOMES WHERE 1=1 AND SUB_AREA_ID = :sub_area_id ORDER BY SUB_AREA_ID) RAS ORDER BY CNT DESC

SELECT ALM.RES_ID, ALARM_ID, ALARM_MSG, CNT, D, S, G, EFFECT FROM (SELECT RES_ID, ALARM_ID, ALARM_MSG, COUNT(*) CNT, SUM(DECODE(SHIFT, 'D', 1)) AS D, SUM(DECODE(SHIFT, 'S', 1)) AS S, SUM(DECODE(SHIFT, 'N', 1)) AS G, SUM(EFFECT) EFFECT, RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS RANK FROM TBP_EQUIP_ALARM WHERE 1=1 AND SET_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:sttime,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(:endtime,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') AND FACTORY = 'HMKA1' ?? GROUP BY RES_ID, ALARM_ID, ALARM_MSG) ALM,
(SELECT DISTINCT RES_ID, AREA_ID, SUB_AREA_ID FROM MESMGR.MRASRESDEF@FATOMES WHERE 1=1 AND SUB_AREA_ID = :sub_area_id ORDER BY SUB_AREA_ID) RAS WHERE 1=1 AND ALM.RES_ID = RAS.RES_ID ORDER BY CNT DESC

SELECT ALM.RES_ID, ALARM_ID, ALARM_MSG, CNT, EFFECT FROM (SELECT RES_ID, ALARM_ID, ALARM_MSG, COUNT(*) CNT, SUM(DECODE(SHIFT, 'D', 1)) AS D, SUM(DECODE(SHIFT, 'S', 1)) AS S, SUM(DECODE(SHIFT, 'N', 1)) AS G, SUM(EFFECT) EFFECT, RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS RANK FROM TBP_EQUIP_ALARM WHERE 1=1 AND SET_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:sttime,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(:endtime,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') AND FACTORY = 'HMKA1' ?? GROUP BY RES_ID, ALARM_ID, ALARM_MSG) ALM,
(SELECT DISTINCT RES_GRP_6, RES_ID FROM MESMGR.MRASRESDEF@FATOMES WHERE 1=1 AND RES_GRP_6 = :res_model ORDER BY RES_ID) RAS WHERE 1=1 AND ALM.RES_ID = RAS.RES_ID ORDER BY CNT DESC

SELECT RES_ID, WORK_DATE, COUNT(*) AS "ALL", COUNT(DECODE(WORK_HOUR,'06',1,'07',1,'08',1,'09',1,'10',1,'11',1,'12',1,'13',1)) AS "DAY", COUNT(DECODE(WORK_HOUR,'14',1,'15',1,'16',1,'17',1,'18',1,'19',1,'20',1,'21',1)) AS SW, COUNT(DECODE(WORK_HOUR,'22',1,'23',1,'00',1,'01',1,'02',1,'03',1,'04',1,'05',1)) AS GY FROM ( SELECT RES.RES_ID, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(HIS.TRAN_TIME,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY/MM/DD') AS WORK_DATE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(HIS.TRAN_TIME,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'HH24') AS WORK_HOUR FROM MESMGR.MRASALMHIS@FATOMES HIS, MESMGR.MRASRESDEF@FATOMES RES WHERE 1=1 AND HIS.FACTORY = RES.FACTORY AND HIS.RES_ID = RES.RES_ID AND RES.FACTORY = 'HMKA1' AND RES.DELETE_FLAG = ' ' AND HIS.TRAN_TIME BETWEEN :sttime AND :endtime AND RES.RES_ID IN (??) ) WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY RES_ID,WORK_DATE ORDER BY "ALL" DESC

SELECT RES_ID, SET_TIME, CLR_TIME, TO_CHAR(MONTH) AS MONTH, DAY, SHIFT, FACTORY, OPER, MAT_ID, LOT_ID, RECIPE_ID, ALARM_ID, ALARM_CAT, ALARM_MSG, CLEAR_CAT, CLEAR_MSG, STATE, PERIOD, EFFECT FROM TBP_EQUIP_ALARM WHERE 1=1 AND FACTORY = 'HMKA1' AND RES_ID IN (??) AND SET_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:sttime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(:endtime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') -- AND SET_TIME BETWEEN :sttime AND :endtime ORDER BY RES_ID

SELECT RES_ID, ALARM_ID, DECODE(REPLACE(ALARM_MSG, ',' , ' '), '', 'NULL', REPLACE(ALARM_MSG, ',' , ' ')) AS ALARM_MSG, COUNT(*) CNT FROM TBP_EQUIP_ALARM WHERE 1=1 AND FACTORY = 'HMKA1' AND RES_ID IN (??) --AND SET_TIME BETWEEN :sttime AND :endtime AND SET_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:sttime,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(:endtime, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') GROUP BY RES_ID, ALARM_ID, ALARM_MSG ORDER BY RES_ID, CNT DESC

SELECT ALARM_MSG, CNT, EFFECT, ALARM_ID FROM (SELECT ALARM_ID, RES_ID, ALARM_MSG ,COUNT(*) CNT, SUM(EFFECT) EFFECT, RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS RANK FROM TBP_EQUIP_ALARM WHERE 1 = 1 AND SET_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:sttime,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(:endtime,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') AND RES_ID = :res_id GROUP BY ALARM_ID, RES_ID, ALARM_MSG) WHERE 1 = 1 AND RANK <= :rcnt ORDER BY 3 DESC

SELECT ALARM_ID , RES_ID AS "EQUIP ID" ,TO_CHAR(SET_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "EVENT TIME" ,TO_CHAR(CLR_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "CLEAR TIME" ,PERIOD AS "TERM(Sec)" ,MAT_ID ,OPER AS "OPER ID" ,'' AS "PART ID" ,RECIPE_ID AS "RECIPE ID" ,LOT_ID AS "LOT ID" ,STATE ,EFFECT ,ALARM_MSG ,CLEAR_MSG FROM TBP_EQUIP_ALARM WHERE 1=1 AND SET_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:dt_start,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') - 1 AND TO_DATE(:dt_end,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') + 1 AND RES_ID = :res_id AND LOT_ID = :lot_id

INSERT INTO TBP_EQUIP_ALARM ( RES_ID ,SET_TIME ,CLR_TIME ,MONTH ,DAY ,SHIFT ,FACTORY ,OPER ,MAT_ID ,LOT_ID ,RECIPE_ID ,ALARM_ID ,ALARM_CAT ,ALARM_MSG ,STATE ,PERIOD ) VALUES( :res_id ,SYSTIMESTAMP ,SYSTIMESTAMP + 1/86400--초기 RELEASE 시간은 발생시간과 동일시간 ,TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP,'YYYYMM') ,TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP,'DD') ,DECODE( TRUNC(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP + (2/24),'HH24')) / 8) , 0 , 'N' , 1 , 'D' ,'S') ,:factory ,:str_oper ,:mat_id ,:lot_id ,:recipe_id ,:alarm_id ,:alarm_cat ,:alarm_msg ,'S' ,1 )

SELECT DAILY, ALARM_ID, ALARM_MSG, CNT, RANK FROM (SELECT TO_CHAR(SET_TIME, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS DAILY, ALARM_ID, ALARM_MSG, COUNT(*) AS CNT, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS RANK FROM TBP_EQUIP_ALARM WHERE 1=1 AND FACTORY = 'HMKA1' ?? AND SET_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:sttime,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(:endtime,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') ?? GROUP BY TO_CHAR(SET_TIME, 'YYYY/MM/DD'), ALARM_MSG, ALARM_ID ORDER BY TO_CHAR(SET_TIME, 'YYYY/MM/DD'), ALARM_MSG) WHERE 1=1 AND RANK <= :rcnt

SELECT RES_ID, SET_TIME, CLR_TIME, OPER, MAT_ID, LOT_ID, RECIPE_ID, ALARM_MSG, CLEAR_MSG, PERIOD, EFFECT FROM TBP_EQUIP_ALARM WHERE 1=1 ?? --AND SET_TIME BETWEEN :sttime AND :endtime AND SET_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:sttime,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(:endtime, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') ?? ORDER BY SET_TIME, ALARM_MSG

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ALARM_ID, ALARM_MSG, COUNT(*) CNT, SUM(EFFECT) EFFECT, RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS RANK FROM ( SELECT ALARM_ID, ALARM_MSG, EFFECT, MONTH || '-'|| DAY DAYS FROM TBP_EQUIP_ALARM WHERE MONTH BETWEEN (:sMonth) AND (:eMonth) AND SET_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE (:sTime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE (:eTime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND OPER IN (SELECT OPER FROM MWIPOPRDEF@FATOMES WHERE OPER_GRP_4 = :sOper) AND DECODE(:resID, 'All', '%,' || RES_ID || ',%', ','||:resID||',') LIKE '%,' || RES_ID || ',%' AND DECODE(:alarm, 'All', '%,' || ALARM_MSG || ',%', ','||:alarm||',') LIKE '%,' || ALARM_MSG || ',%' ) WHERE DAYS BETWEEN (:sDay) AND (:eDay) GROUP BY ALARM_ID, ALARM_MSG ) WHERE 1 = 1 AND RANK <=:rank ORDER BY 3 DESC

SELECT ALARM_ID, RES_ID, SET_TIME, CLR_TIME, OPER, MAT_ID, LOT_ID, RECIPE_ID, ALARM_MSG, CLEAR_MSG, PERIOD, EFFECT FROM TBP_EQUIP_ALARM WHERE 1=1 AND SET_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:sTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(:eTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND ALARM_ID= :ID AND ?? = :value AND DECODE(:resID, 'All', '%,' || RES_ID || ',%', ','||:resID||',') LIKE '%,' || RES_ID || ',%' ORDER BY SET_TIME

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT MAT_ID, COUNT(*) CNT, SUM(EFFECT) EFFECT, RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS RANK FROM ( SELECT MAT_ID, EFFECT, MONTH || '-'|| DAY DAYS FROM TBP_EQUIP_ALARM WHERE MONTH BETWEEN (:sMonth) AND (:eMonth) AND SET_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE (:sTime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE (:eTime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND OPER IN (SELECT OPER FROM MWIPOPRDEF@FATOMES WHERE OPER_GRP_4 = :sOper) AND DECODE(:resID, 'All', '%,' || RES_ID || ',%', ','||:resID||',') LIKE '%,' || RES_ID || ',%' AND DECODE(:matID, 'All', '%,' || MAT_ID || ',%', ','||:matID||',') LIKE '%,' || MAT_ID || ',%' AND DECODE(:alarm, 'All', '%,' || ALARM_MSG || ',%', ','||:alarm||',') LIKE '%,' || ALARM_MSG || ',%' ) WHERE DAYS BETWEEN (:sDay) AND (:eDay) GROUP BY MAT_ID ) WHERE 1 = 1 AND RANK <=:rank ORDER BY 3 DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ALARM_ID, RES_ID, COUNT(*) CNT, SUM(EFFECT) EFFECT, RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS RANK FROM ( SELECT ALARM_ID, RES_ID, EFFECT, MONTH || '-'|| DAY DAYS FROM TBP_EQUIP_ALARM WHERE MONTH BETWEEN (:sMonth) AND (:eMonth) AND SET_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE (:sTime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE (:eTime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND OPER IN (SELECT OPER FROM MWIPOPRDEF@FATOMES WHERE OPER_GRP_4 = :sOper) AND DECODE(:resID, 'All', '%,' || RES_ID || ',%', ','||:resID||',') LIKE '%,' || RES_ID || ',%' AND DECODE(:alarm, 'All', '%,' || ALARM_MSG || ',%', ','||:alarm||',') LIKE '%,' || ALARM_MSG || ',%' ) WHERE DAYS BETWEEN (:sDay) AND (:eDay) GROUP BY ALARM_ID, RES_ID ) WHERE 1 = 1 AND RANK <=:rank ORDER BY 3 DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ALARM_CODE, COUNT(*) CNT, SUM(EFFECT) EFFECT, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS RANK FROM MRASALMDEF@FATOMES A LEFT OUTER JOIN TBP_EQUIP_ALARM B ON A.ALARM_ID = TO_CHAR(B.ALARM_ID) WHERE MONTH ||'-'|| DAY BETWEEN :sDay AND :eDay AND SET_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE (:sTime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE (:eTime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND OPER IN (SELECT OPER FROM MWIPOPRDEF@FATOMES WHERE OPER_GRP_4 = :sOper) AND DECODE(:resId, 'All', '%,' || RES_ID || ',%', ','||:resId||',') LIKE '%,' || RES_ID || ',%' AND DECODE(:matId, 'All', '%,' || MAT_ID || ',%', ','||:matId||',') LIKE '%,' || MAT_ID || ',%' AND DECODE(:alarm, 'All', '%,' || ALARM_MSG || ',%', ','||:alarm||',') LIKE '%,' || ALARM_MSG || ',%' GROUP BY ALARM_CODE ) WHERE 1 = 1 AND RANK <= :rank ORDER BY ALARM_CODE DESC

SELECT DISTINCT ALARM_CODE FROM MRASALMDEF@FATOMES WHERE CREATE_TIME BETWEEN (:sTime) AND (:eTime) AND DECODE(:model, 'All', '%,' || MODEL || ',%', ','||:model||',') LIKE '%,' || MODEL || ',%' --AND MODEL = DECODE(:model, 'All', MODEL, :model) ORDER BY ALARM_CODE

SELECT DISTINCT ALARM_MSG FROM TBP_EQUIP_ALARM WHERE MONTH BETWEEN :sMonth AND :eMonth AND SET_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:sTime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE(:eTime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND OPER IN (SELECT OPER FROM MWIPOPRDEF@FATOMES WHERE OPER_GRP_4 = :sOper) AND DECODE(:resID, 'All', '%,' || RES_ID || ',%', ','||:resID||',') LIKE '%,' || RES_ID || ',%' ORDER BY ALARM_MSG

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT TIME, ALARM_ID, ALARM_MSG, COUNT(*) CNT, SUM(EFFECT) EFFECT, ?? FROM ( SELECT SET_TIME AS TIME, ALARM_ID, ALARM_MSG, EFFECT, MONTH || '-'|| DAY DAYS ,?? FROM TBP_EQUIP_ALARM WHERE MONTH BETWEEN (:sMonth) AND (:eMonth) AND SET_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE (:sTime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE (:eTime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND DECODE(:resID, 'All', '%,' || RES_ID || ',%', ','||:resID||',') LIKE '%,' || RES_ID || ',%' AND DECODE(:alarm, 'All', '%,' || ALARM_MSG || ',%', ','||:alarm||',') LIKE '%,' || ALARM_MSG || ',%' ) WHERE DAYS BETWEEN :sDays AND :eDays GROUP BY TIME, ALARM_ID, ALARM_MSG, ?? ) WHERE 1 = 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC

-- col1, col2, col2, sQuery, rank, sOper, sModel SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ??, CNT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CNT DESC) AS RANKING FROM ( SELECT ??, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM MRASALMDEF@FATOMES A LEFT OUTER JOIN TBP_EQUIP_ALARM B ON A.ALARM_ID = TO_CHAR(B.ALARM_ID) WHERE B.FACTORY = 'HMKA1' AND B.OPER IN (SELECT OPER FROM MWIPOPRDEF@FATOMES WHERE FACTORY = 'HMKA1' AND OPER_GRP_4 = :sOper) AND B.SET_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE (:sTime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE (:eTime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND DECODE(:sModel, 'All', '%,' || MODEL || ',%', ','||:sModel||',') LIKE '%,' || MODEL || ',%' AND DECODE(:sRes, 'All', '%,' || RES_ID || ',%', ','||:sRes||',') LIKE '%,' || RES_ID || ',%' AND DECODE(:sMat, 'All', '%,' || MAT_ID || ',%', ','||:sMat||',') LIKE '%,' || MAT_ID || ',%' AND DECODE(:sAlarm, 'All', '%,' || ALARM_MSG || ',%', ','||:sAlarm||',') LIKE '%,' || ALARM_MSG || ',%' ?? GROUP BY ?? ) ) WHERE 1=1 AND RANKING ??

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ??, COUNT(*) CNT, SUM(EFFECT) EFFECT, RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS RANK FROM TBP_EQUIP_ALARM WHERE MONTH ||'-'|| DAY BETWEEN :sDay AND :eDay AND SET_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE (:sTime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE (:eTime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND OPER IN (SELECT OPER FROM MWIPOPRDEF@FATOMES WHERE OPER_GRP_4 = :sOper) AND RES_ID = DECODE(:resId, 'All', RES_ID, :resId) AND MAT_ID = DECODE(:matId, 'All', MAT_ID, :matId) AND ALARM_MSG = DECODE(:alarm, 'All', ALARM_MSG, :alarm) --AND DECODE(:resId, 'All', '%,' || RES_ID || ',%', ','||:resId||',') LIKE '%,' || RES_ID || ',%' --AND DECODE(:matId, 'All', '%,' || MAT_ID || ',%', ','||:matId||',') LIKE '%,' || MAT_ID || ',%' --AND DECODE(:alarm, 'All', '%,' || ALARM_MSG || ',%', ','||:alarm||',') LIKE '%,' || ALARM_MSG || ',%' GROUP BY ?? ) WHERE 1 = 1 AND RANK <= :rank ORDER BY 4 ASC

SELECT OPER, ALARM_CODE, COUNT(*) CNT, ?? FROM MRASALMDEF@FATOMES A LEFT OUTER JOIN TBP_EQUIP_ALARM B ON A.ALARM_ID = TO_CHAR(B.ALARM_ID) WHERE 1=1 AND MONTH ||'-'|| DAY BETWEEN :sDay AND :eDay AND SET_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE (:sTime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE (:eTime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND OPER IN (SELECT OPER FROM MWIPOPRDEF@FATOMES WHERE OPER_GRP_4 = :sOper) AND DECODE(:resId, 'All', '%,' || RES_ID || ',%', ','||:resId||',') LIKE '%,' || RES_ID || ',%' AND DECODE(:matId, 'All', '%,' || MAT_ID || ',%', ','||:matId||',') LIKE '%,' || MAT_ID || ',%' AND DECODE(:alarm, 'All', '%,' || ALARM_MSG || ',%', ','||:alarm||',') LIKE '%,' || ALARM_MSG || ',%' GROUP BY OPER, ALARM_CODE, ?? ORDER BY 4 ASC

-- col1, col2, col2, sQuery, rank, sOper, sModel SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ??, CNT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CNT DESC) AS RANKING FROM ( SELECT ??, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM MRASALMDEF@FATOMES A LEFT OUTER JOIN TBP_EQUIP_ALARM B ON A.ALARM_ID = TO_CHAR(B.ALARM_ID) WHERE B.FACTORY = 'HMKA1' AND B.OPER IN (SELECT OPER FROM MWIPOPRDEF@FATOMES WHERE FACTORY = 'HMKA1' AND OPER_GRP_4 = :sOper) AND B.SET_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE (:sTime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE (:eTime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND A.MODEL = :sModel ?? ?? GROUP BY ?? ) ) WHERE 1=1 AND RANKING ??

SELECT TO_DATE(DAY, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DAY , ALARM_ID AS VALUE, ALARM_DESC , CNT, SUM(CNT) OVER (PARTITION BY DAY) AS SUM FROM ( SELECT DAY, ALARM_ID, ALARM_DESC, COUNT(*) CNT FROM ( SELECT TO_CHAR(B.SET_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DAY, A.ALARM_ID, A.ALARM_DESC FROM MRASALMDEF@FATOMES A LEFT OUTER JOIN TBP_EQUIP_ALARM B ON A.ALARM_ID = TO_CHAR(B.ALARM_ID) WHERE B.FACTORY = 'HMKA1' AND B.OPER IN (SELECT OPER FROM MWIPOPRDEF@FATOMES WHERE FACTORY = 'HMKA1' AND OPER_GRP_4 = :sOper) AND B.SET_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE (:sTime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE (:eTime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND A.MODEL = :sModel ?? AND A.ALARM_ID IN (??) GROUP BY B.SET_TIME, A.ALARM_ID, A.ALARM_DESC ) GROUP BY DAY, ALARM_ID, ALARM_DESC )

SELECT TO_DATE(DAY, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DAY , RES_ID AS VALUE , CNT, SUM(CNT) OVER (PARTITION BY DAY) AS SUM FROM ( SELECT DAY, RES_ID, COUNT(*) CNT FROM ( SELECT TO_CHAR(B.SET_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DAY, B.RES_ID FROM MRASALMDEF@FATOMES A LEFT OUTER JOIN TBP_EQUIP_ALARM B ON A.ALARM_ID = TO_CHAR(B.ALARM_ID) WHERE B.FACTORY = 'HMKA1' AND B.OPER IN (SELECT OPER FROM MWIPOPRDEF@FATOMES WHERE FACTORY = 'HMKA1' AND OPER_GRP_4 = :sOper) AND B.SET_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE (:sTime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE (:eTime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND A.MODEL = :sModel ?? AND B.RES_ID IN (??) GROUP BY B.SET_TIME, B.RES_ID ) GROUP BY DAY, RES_ID )

SELECT TO_DATE(DAY, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DAY , MAT_ID AS VALUE , CNT, SUM(CNT) OVER (PARTITION BY DAY) AS SUM FROM ( SELECT DAY, MAT_ID, COUNT(*) CNT FROM ( SELECT TO_CHAR(B.SET_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DAY, B.MAT_ID FROM MRASALMDEF@FATOMES A LEFT OUTER JOIN TBP_EQUIP_ALARM B ON A.ALARM_ID = TO_CHAR(B.ALARM_ID) WHERE B.FACTORY = 'HMKA1' AND B.OPER IN (SELECT OPER FROM MWIPOPRDEF@FATOMES WHERE FACTORY = 'HMKA1' AND OPER_GRP_4 = :sOper) AND B.SET_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE (:sTime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE (:eTime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND A.MODEL = :sModel ?? AND B.MAT_ID IN (??) GROUP BY B.SET_TIME, B.MAT_ID ) GROUP BY DAY, MAT_ID )

--sCol, sQuery, sRank SELECT * FROM ( SELECT WEEK , ?? AS VALUE, CNT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CNT DESC) AS RANKING FROM ( SELECT WEEK, ??, COUNT(*) CNT FROM ( SELECT TO_CHAR(SET_TIME, 'YYYYIW') AS WEEK, ?? FROM MRASALMDEF@FATOMES A LEFT OUTER JOIN TBP_EQUIP_ALARM B ON A.ALARM_ID = TO_CHAR(B.ALARM_ID) WHERE 1=1 AND SET_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE (:sTime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE (:eTime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND OPER IN (SELECT OPER FROM MWIPOPRDEF@FATOMES WHERE OPER_GRP_4 = :sOper) AND DECODE(:sModel, 'All', '%,' || MODEL || ',%', ','||:sModel||',') LIKE '%,' || MODEL || ',%' AND DECODE(:sRes, 'All', '%,' || RES_ID || ',%', ','||:sRes||',') LIKE '%,' || RES_ID || ',%' AND DECODE(:sMat, 'All', '%,' || MAT_ID || ',%', ','||:sMat||',') LIKE '%,' || MAT_ID || ',%' AND DECODE(:sAlarm, 'All', '%,' || ALARM_MSG || ',%', ','||:sAlarm||',') LIKE '%,' || ALARM_MSG || ',%' ?? GROUP BY MAT_ID, SET_TIME ) GROUP BY WEEK, ?? ) ) WHERE 1=1 AND RANKING ??

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT MONTH , ?? AS VALUE, CNT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CNT DESC) AS RANKING FROM ( SELECT MONTH, ??, COUNT(*) CNT FROM ( SELECT MONTH, ?? FROM MRASALMDEF@FATOMES A LEFT OUTER JOIN TBP_EQUIP_ALARM B ON A.ALARM_ID = TO_CHAR(B.ALARM_ID) WHERE 1=1 AND SET_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE (:sTime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE (:eTime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND OPER IN (SELECT OPER FROM MWIPOPRDEF@FATOMES WHERE OPER_GRP_4 = :sOper) AND DECODE(:sModel, 'All', '%,' || MODEL || ',%', ','||:sModel||',') LIKE '%,' || MODEL || ',%' AND DECODE(:sRes, 'All', '%,' || RES_ID || ',%', ','||:sRes||',') LIKE '%,' || RES_ID || ',%' AND DECODE(:sMat, 'All', '%,' || MAT_ID || ',%', ','||:sMat||',') LIKE '%,' || MAT_ID || ',%' AND DECODE(:sAlarm, 'All', '%,' || ALARM_MSG || ',%', ','||:sAlarm||',') LIKE '%,' || ALARM_MSG || ',%' ?? GROUP BY ??, MONTH ) GROUP BY MONTH, ?? ) ) WHERE 1=1 AND RANKING ??

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT TO_DATE(DAY, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) AS DAY , ?? AS VALUE, CNT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CNT DESC) AS RANKING FROM ( SELECT DAY, ??, COUNT(*) CNT FROM ( SELECT TO_CHAR(SET_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DAY, ?? FROM MRASALMDEF@FATOMES A LEFT OUTER JOIN TBP_EQUIP_ALARM B ON A.ALARM_ID = TO_CHAR(B.ALARM_ID) WHERE 1=1 AND SET_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE (:sTime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND TO_DATE (:eTime,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND OPER IN (SELECT OPER FROM MWIPOPRDEF@FATOMES WHERE OPER_GRP_4 = :sOper) AND DECODE(:sModel, 'All', '%,' || MODEL || ',%', ','||:sModel||',') LIKE '%,' || MODEL || ',%' AND DECODE(:sRes, 'All', '%,' || RES_ID || ',%', ','||:sRes||',') LIKE '%,' || RES_ID || ',%' AND DECODE(_sMat, 'All', '%,' || MAT_ID || ',%', ','||:sMat||',') LIKE '%,' || MAT_ID || ',%' AND DECODE(:sAlarm, 'All', '%,' || ALARM_MSG || ',%', ','||:sAlarm||',') LIKE '%,' || ALARM_MSG || ',%' ?? GROUP BY ??, SET_TIME ) GROUP BY DAY, ?? ) ) WHERE 1=1 AND RANKING ??

SELECT MES.RES_OPER AS RES_OPER , NVL(MES.RES_MODEL, ' ') AS RES_MODEL , ' ' AS RES_ID , ' ' MAT_ID , ' ' OPER , NVL(ALARM_DESC, ' ') AS ALARM_DESC , SUM(MES.ALARM_CNT) ALARM_CNT , ROUND(SUM(DISTINCT MES.MES_RUN_TIME) / DECODE(SUM(MES.ALARM_CNT),0,1,SUM(MES.ALARM_CNT)),2) AS MES_MTBA , ROUND(SUM(DISTINCT FA.FA_RUN_TIME) / DECODE(SUM(MES.ALARM_CNT),0,1,SUM(MES.ALARM_CNT)),2) AS FA_MTBA , ROUND(SUM(DISTINCT MES.MES_RUN_TIME),2) AS MES_RUN_TIME , ROUND(SUM(DISTINCT FA.FA_RUN_TIME),2) AS FA_RUN_TIME , ROUND(100 * SUM(EFFECT_TIME) / (COUNT(DISTINCT MAX(RES_USE.RES_ID)) OVER (PARTITION BY MES.RES_MODEL) * (( (TO_DATE(:end_day,'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(:start_day,'YYYYMMDD')) + 1 ) * 1440 )),2) AS "시간율" , ROUND(SUM(EFFECT_TIME),2) AS EFFECT_TIME -- 2013. 12. 26 add fa-effect time , COUNT(DISTINCT MAX(RES_USE.RES_ID)) OVER (PARTITION BY MES.RES_MODEL) * (( (TO_DATE(:end_day,'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(:start_day,'YYYYMMDD')) + 1 ) * 1440 ) AS WORK_TIME FROM ( SELECT TO_CHAR(SET_TIME + 2/24, 'YYYYMMDD') AS WORK_DAY , DEF.RES_GRP_3 AS RES_OPER , DEF.RES_GRP_6 AS RES_MODEL , DEF.RES_ID AS RES_ID , MAX(RUN_TIME) AS MES_RUN_TIME , ALM.ALARM_MSG AS ALARM_DESC , COUNT(1) AS ALARM_CNT , SUM(ALM.EFFECT)/60 EFFECT_TIME FROM TBP_EQUIP_ALARM ALM , MRASRESDEF@FATOMES DEF , ( SELECT WORK_DAY, ALM.FACTORY, DEF.RES_GRP_6, ALM.RES_ID , SUM(MAX(RUN_TIME)) OVER (PARTITION BY RES_GRP_6) AS RUN_TIME , SUM(ALARM_CNT) AS CNT FROM CSUMALMRES@FATOMES ALM, MRASRESDEF@FATOMES DEF WHERE WORK_DAY BETWEEN :start_day AND :end_day AND ALM.RES_ID = DEF.RES_ID GROUP BY WORK_DAY, ALM.FACTORY, RES_GRP_6, ALM.RES_ID ) RES_SUM WHERE SET_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:start_day||'220000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') - 1 AND TO_DATE(:end_day || '215959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND DEF.RES_ID = ALM.RES_ID AND DEF.RES_ID = RES_SUM.RES_ID ?? ?? ?? AND ALM.FACTORY = 'HMKA1' GROUP BY TO_CHAR(SET_TIME + 2/24, 'YYYYMMDD'), DEF.RES_GRP_3, DEF.RES_GRP_6 , DEF.RES_ID, ALM.ALARM_MSG ) MES , (SELECT WORK_DAY, RES_OPER, RES_MODEL, RES_ID, SUM(FA_RUN_TIME + FA_INDEX_TIME) / 60 AS FA_RUN_TIME FROM TSM_EQUIP_PROC_RESULT WHERE WORK_MONTH BETWEEN SUBSTR(:start_day,1,6) AND SUBSTR(:end_day,1,6) AND WORK_DAY BETWEEN :start_day AND :end_day GROUP BY WORK_DAY,RES_OPER, RES_MODEL, RES_ID ) FA , ( SELECT SUBSTR(CUTOFF_DT, 1, 8) AS WORK_DAY , RES_GRP_3 AS RES_OPER , RES_GRP_5 AS RES_MAKER , RES_GRP_6 AS RES_MODEL , RES_ID AS RES_ID , RES_CMF_9 AS USE_STATE FROM MRASRESDEF_BOH@FATOMES RES , ( SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE (:start_day, 'YYYYMMDD')+(LEVEL - 1), 'YYYYMMDD') DAY FROM DUAL CONNECT BY TO_DATE (:start_day, 'YYYYMMDD')+(LEVEL-1) <=TO_DATE (:end_day, 'YYYYMMDD') ) YMD WHERE RES.FACTORY = 'HMKA1' AND RES.CUTOFF_DT = YMD.DAY || '22' AND RES.DELETE_FLAG = ' ' ) RES_USE WHERE MES.RES_OPER = FA.RES_OPER AND MES.RES_MODEL = FA.RES_MODEL AND MES.RES_ID = FA.RES_ID AND MES.RES_ID = RES_USE.RES_ID AND MES.WORK_DAY = RES_USE.WORK_DAY AND MES.WORK_DAY = FA.WORK_DAY AND RES_USE.USE_STATE = 'Y' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (MES.RES_OPER, MES.RES_MODEL, ALARM_DESC) -- 6th ) HAVING SUM(MES.ALARM_CNT) <> 0
DELETE FROM TBP_EQUIP_ALARM WHERE 1=1 AND SET_TIME < SYSDATE - :delete_day

SELECT /*+INDEX_DESC(ALM TBP_EQUIP_ALARM_PK)*/TO_CHAR(SET_TIME,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS TRAN_TIME FROM (SELECT * FROM TBP_EQUIP_ALARM WHERE 1=1 and OPER = :oper and FACTORY = 'HMKA1' AND MONTH IN (TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMM'), TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE,-1),'YYYYMM')) and ALARM_ID IN ('2184', '2185', '2500', '2501', '2660', '2661', '2662', '2663') and RES_ID = :res_id order by SET_TIME DESC) ALM where 1=1 and ROWNUM = 1
